Why isn't this all over the news?
#MeToo #TimesUp Seems to be right on message, but not a peep.

Why?

This is a pattern. White school bus driver who raped a child, no jail time. Where the hell is #MeToo in addressing legislation & judicial prejudice when a conviction occurs. Forget listening, what about ensuring when they are heard, legal justice is served? #socialworker
